verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Floot acting only as an MCP server that external clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code connect to. Nothing shows Floot letting users plug third-party MCP servers into it as a client. An AI app builder could plausibly offer MCP-client connectors, so the axis applies, but its server-side MCP support does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
